# Dawid Olko: CV

> CV of Dawid Olko, a fullstack / AI developer from Rzeszów, Poland, and co-creator of Skribly. Available as a page and as a PDF in Polish and English.

## CV

- [CV in Polish](https://cv.dawidolko.pl/): Experience, skills, education and selected projects.
- [CV in English](https://cv.dawidolko.pl/en/): The same CV in English.
- [PDF in Polish](https://cv.dawidolko.pl/Dawid_Olko_CV_PL.pdf): One A4 page for printing.
- [PDF in English](https://cv.dawidolko.pl/Dawid_Olko_CV_EN.pdf): One A4 page for printing.

## Links

- [Website](https://dawidolko.pl/): Personal site with projects, studies and contact.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/dawidolko): Source code of public projects.
- [Skribly](https://skribly.pl/): Non-commercial tools for building software with AI agents.
